title: 8. Handling Missing Data
description: Detect missing values and apply mean, median, and mode imputation with scikit-learn.

blocks.content:
### Missing Value Imputation

Real-world data contains gaps (`NaN`).

![Missing Values Percentage per Column](/images/ml/chart_missing_data.png)

#### Imputation Strategies
- **Median Imputation**: Best for numeric columns with outliers.
- **Mean Imputation**: Good for symmetric numeric columns without heavy outliers.
- **Most Frequent (Mode)**: Best for missing categorical strings.

blocks.starterCode:
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.impute import SimpleImputer

df = pd.DataFrame({'age': [22, 25, np.nan, 29, 100]})
imputer = SimpleImputer(strategy='median')
df['age_imputed'] = imputer.fit_transform(df[['age']])
print(df)
